deployments_detail.use: AI in WhatsApp and webchat customer service replacing rigid workflows with intelligent customer journeys

AI-powered customer service on WhatsApp and Webchat (Weflow platform): intelligent routing, integration with internal systems, image analysis of user-submitted leak photos, and automated self-service flows (debt installments, water reconnection, bill delivery). [Weflow]
AI-based network monitoring to detect and reduce water leaks (4Fluid startup partnership; also Orion Alfa sensor pilot in Araxá)

AI acoustic leak detection (4Fluid by Stattus4): AI analyzes noise captured by electronic collectors near water meters to locate hidden underground leaks; first deployed in Curvelo (Jul 2023) and Pompeu (Aug 2023), with planned rollout to Conselheiro Lafaiete, Divinopolis, Nova Serrana and Tres Marias. [Stattus4 (4Fluid)]
4Fluid AI leak-detection deployed in Bambui for one year: AI-driven acoustic analysis identified and eliminated hidden water leaks, reducing distribution losses in the city. [Stattus4 (4Fluid)]
deployments_detail.value: 14% reduction in water losses; 52 leak points identified and eliminated over 12 months (12,759 acoustic collections)

deployments_detail.use: 4Fluid Movel in Araxa: portable AI acoustic device predicts potential leaks in distribution networks/branches, optimizing the geophonist's work and cutting leak-detection time. [Stattus4 (4Fluid Movel)]
deployments_detail.value: reduction of roughly 1,138 m3/day in losses after repairs (equivalent to ~34,140 water tanks/month); double the suspect points identified, ~80% confirmed

deployments_detail.use: 4Fluid AI leak-detection deployed in Januaria and Itacarambi to control water losses. [Stattus4 (4Fluid)]
deployments_detail.value: ~R$40 thousand invested; goal to reduce losses from 20.25% to 17%

deployments_detail.use: ADA pressure-monitoring system in Araxa (Alvorada neighborhood): AI-linked sensors installed beside water meters continuously measure network pressure and send data to cloud software to pinpoint leak locations for faster repairs. [Stattus4 (ADA)]
deployments_detail.value: R$55 thousand system; 30 sensors covering 30 km of networks; 12-month trial

deployments_detail.use: Orion Alfa AI pressure sensors (Galax.ia) tested in Araxa: sensors monitor network pressure and send data to cloud software that uses AI to identify leak patterns via pressure variation. [Galax.ia (Orion Alfa)]
deployments_detail.value: 24 devices across 6 neighborhoods serving 110,000+ residents; 12-month test; no cost to Copasa (technical cooperation)

deployments_detail.use: AI-integrated video monitoring of operational units (Teltex): intelligent video-monitoring platform with alarm centers and siren activation used to monitor dam water levels, sewage-treatment processes, and support preventive actions; centralized in a main Operations Control Center in Belo Horizonte plus five regional centers. [Teltex Tecnologia]
deployments_detail.value: Phase 1: 270 operational units across Minas Gerais; Phase 2 expansion to Divinopolis (Dec 2025); further expansion to 8 dams in Northern Minas
